description: NEW (Nov 2026) — Kie Video Upscale: upscale ANY video (not just Veo output) to 1080P / 2K / 4K, keeping aspect ratio, frame rate, frame count and audio. resolution is an output box: the source is fitted into it without cropping (a larger source is scaled down and enhanced). 1.5 / 3 / 6 cr per second of input for 1080P / 2K / 4K. Input: public URL, MP4/MOV/MKV, ≤50 MB, ≤60 s (checked after download, so an over-limit video fails the task). Output is MP4 (H.264 + AAC). Upload local files with upload_file first.

download_dir.description: Absolute directory to save into (created if missing). Defaults to the server's kie/assets/raw/.

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

max_wait_seconds.description: Override the blocking-mode polling budget in seconds. Ignored when wait=false.

resolution.description: Output box: 1920×1080 / 2560×1440 / 3840×2160 (or the portrait equivalents). 1.5 / 3 / 6 cr per second

video_seconds.description: Length of the source video in seconds — only used for the cost estimate (estimate_only / max_credits)

video_url.description: Public URL of the source video (≤50 MB, ≤60 s)

wait.description: Set false to submit and return immediately with the task_id (async mode) — then poll with check_task and fetch with download_result.

name: upscale_video
